## Today {.inverse}

<span class="kicker">WED AUG 19 · 3-5 PM</span>

Turn a public source into a documented analysis file, then supervise an agent-assisted update.

## A dataset is a chain of decisions

| Layer | Rule |
|---|---|
| Raw | Never edit by hand |
| Derived | Rebuild with code |
| Analysis | Name each decision |
| Output | Never treat as input |

## The country-year key

```{.r}
stopifnot(
  !anyDuplicated(
    health[c("iso3c", "year")]
  )
)
```

If this fails, **stop**. A later join can otherwise multiply observations silently.

## Build one table

```{.r}
health <- wdi |>
  select(iso3c, country, year, income_level,
         gdp_per_capita_ppp, under5_mortality) |>
  filter(year >= 2000) |>
  mutate(log_income = log(gdp_per_capita_ppp))
```

Every verb should answer a question you can say aloud.

## Update contract

> Extend one named indicator from the official API. Write a new dated file. Preserve the frozen baseline. Record the retrieval date. Test unique keys. Report historical revisions separately from new years.
